profile.headline: Engineering @ CoreWeave
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer focused on backend systems, distributed infrastructure, and AI/ML products. Currently at CoreWeave, building high-performance metrics and storage systems for large-scale ML workloads.
Previously co-founded Lawfully, growing the product from zero to 500K MAU and $2M ARR while building the engineering and product team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Metrics & Storage Team @ Weights & Biases
• Working on a system that handles massive AI models experiment data
• Dealing with runs containing hundreds of thousands of parameters and millions of records, focusing on efficient processing and visualization without imposing hard limits on users including foundational model builders

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Core Platform Engineering Team
• Worked on scaling a legacy monolith and improving its resiliency while supporting its transition toward microservices architecture
• Built shared platform services, such as load testing, autoscaling and 3rd party workout data ingestion pipeline, to reliably support traffic from millions of members

positions.title: Co-founder, Engineering & Product
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Defined the initial conception of the product, built many key elements of the technology
• Grew the product from 0 to 500K MAU & $2M ARR
• Led cross-functional product team
• Founded the company in Seoul and later relocated it to New York
positions.insights: Product Management, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +3 skills
